name: @openagt/devices
description: Your devices and OpenAgent, in one Settings entry, Devices: a phone or another browser gets in by scanning a QR code once, each with its own key, and one switch, On this Wi-Fi, opens the door on the network the computer is on; on a server the door is open over HTTPS, with a certificate it asks for and renews itself. Your other computers send their runs here and get yours, listed once whichever way runs go: one on the same Wi-Fi is found there and connected once someone at it presses Allow, both screens showing the same number. A server is set up from this computer over SSH, with its own SSH keys: OpenAgent installs itself there, starts by itself, gets its GitHub and Claude logins from this computer, and your devices reach each other through it from anywhere.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=60000 'dist-test/**/*.test.js' && cd dashboard && vitest run
